pairs.why: B has the right armless layout, but its thin, spindly tubes lose to A's sturdier, soft-rendered chair, even though A's lime trim and armrests make it a bit toy-like.
A keeps the real card's all-green and grey colours and a solid frame, while B's bright orange armrests add a colour the real card doesn't have.
Both drawings have the same thin, spindly frame and light lime fabric, and neither is clearly closer to the real chair's sturdy tubes and deeper green.
A's deeper green, thicker matte tubes and soft lighting match the real card, while B's thin wire frame with a jutting seat bar looks flimsy, even though it has no arms like the real chair.
Like the real chair, B is armless with a deep green fabric back and seat and chunky grey tubes, while A adds orange armrests the real card doesn't have.
A is a solidly built chair in the real card's green and grey, while B's thin wire frame looks spindly and less usable.
A's orange armrests are off-colour, but its sturdy soft-rendered frame still reads closer to the real chair than B's thin, spindly wire frame.
B's lime trim makes it toy-like, but its sturdy tubes and deeper green beat A's thin, spindly wire frame.
